title: Budget Quality Cutlery
text:
Budget Quality Cutlery. Farberware is not a name I associate with high-end cookware and utensils. That said, I have had good fortune with most of their cookware and I looked to this set as a decent budget set for general cooking. For the price it’s an acceptable set but I would not look to it to last for a long time.

There are three tools in this set – a chef’s knife, a paring knife and a pair of kitchen shears. Right out of the package they’re sharp and ready to go (I’d suggest washing them first, of course). I do not know yet how quickly they’ll dull.

The handles are molded plastic and there is a visible seam on each. That in itself does not concern me but is a clear indicator that these are budget-line utensils. The blades, though, are not full tang and without a little care this can fatigue the handle when each is used. I have visions of the chef’s knife in particular breaking in mid-use when chopping.

I can recommend this set with some reservations. It’s a budget-friendly set of tools for the kitchen that makes a decent starter set, but I question its durability.
